technology.name: The CIRUS research reactor
technology.description: CIRUS, a 40 MW research reactor at Trombay near Bombay supplied by Canada, first went critical in July 1960. It ran on natural uranium with heavy water supplied by the United States.

technology.name: TIFRAC, India's first home-built computer
technology.description: The Tata Institute of Fundamental Research Automatic Calculator, based on the IAS machine design, was formally commissioned and named by Nehru in 1960 and stayed in use until 1965.

technology.name: IIT Kanpur
technology.description: IIT Kanpur began in December 1959 on the campus of the Harcourt Butler Technological Institute and was established by an Act of Parliament in 1960.

technology.name: Bhilai Steel Plant
technology.description: The Bhilai Steel Plant, set up with Soviet help from 1955, became India's main producer of steel rails.

technology.name: Vividh Bharati radio service
technology.description: All India Radio launched the Vividh Bharati entertainment service on 3 October 1957, carrying film music and commercials.
